question: What does FSEC-style p track across training, activation curvature, task complexity and genuine fixed-target denoising?
scope: Exploratory controlled characterization, motivated by known earlier results. No universal activation ranking, no claim that p alone identifies a correction mechanism, no expansion based on favorable p values.

task.latent_values: independent Bernoulli bits, target is the clean 16-bit vector
task.encoder: fixed 32x16 orthonormal-column Gaussian QR matrix, positive QR diagonal convention
task.context_permutation: roll feature indices by 8; context=-1 permutes encoder columns only in context tasks
task.context: uniform ±1, observed exactly and not corrupted; present in all tasks, irrelevant in linear tasks
task.denoise_training: observations A_context*z + independent Gaussian noise, std 0.35 per observed coordinate; target remains clean z

network.initialization: For each initialization seed, common normal encoder std 1/sqrt(33) and decoder std 1/sqrt(64), biases zero; exact same starting weights across activation/task conditions

training.schedule: cosine decay to zero over the full fixed budget
training.objective: sum of per-network means of squared error, preserving independent optimizer scale
training.pairing: All 60 networks share latent examples, context bits, minibatches and standard noise draws. Clean/noisy tasks differ only in multiplying noise by zero or 0.35. Initialization seeds vary weights, not data.

geometry.primary_slice: feature axes, absent pair, ++ sign, median over four matched backgrounds
geometry.control: Coordinate-separable restriction C_j(u_j,r)=f_j(A_r*e_j*u_j,r), where u=A_r^T observation. Exact match to every one-feature response including activation and bias; no cross-latent-feature computation. Uses the known encoder/context and is not capacity matched.
geometry.competence_annotation: Per-feature clean active MSE<0.1, absent MSE<0.05 and correct isolated unit-feature output argmax/gain>0.5; report all fixed pairs regardless
geometry.fitter: Original additive superellipse with 0..60 chart rescaling, plus PSD tilted-quadratic fit, all flags and per-background fits
geometry.fine_check: At final checkpoint, seed 0, first pair, absent ++ feature axes, both natural and separable maps: repeat at 61x61 for all 20 activation/task combinations
geometry.caveat: Continuous and out-of-range perturbations leave the discrete binary training manifold; recovery uses actual held-out corrupted binary examples.

recovery.target: same clean latent bits at every noise level
baselines: known context-aware linear decode clipped to [0,1]
exact factorized Bernoulli-Gaussian posterior mean using known encoder, prior and test noise level
metrics: fraction of oracle-available MSE improvement recovered when denominator is positive
recovery.uncertainty: Three initialization seeds; summarize per seed before aggregating. No pair-fit pseudoreplication, no dataset population claims.

historical_track.activations: all five existing scalar activations, L2/L4, three seeds
historical_track.geometry: Same input-feature direction protocol and coordinate-separable null; record competence instead of selecting on p
historical_track.recovery: Original signed-sparse ReLU target and fixed-target Gaussian input noise, 1024 examples, two paired draws, std 0/0.075/0.15. Full 100 outputs and positive/absent/negative strata; known original target on corrupted input as reference.
historical_track.interpretation: Separate historical biased-free bottleneck task from the new biased coded-bit task. Do not pool them into an activation ranking.

verification: batched gradients and one Adam update equal separate-network execution
task encoder orthogonality and context permutation inversion
Bayes posterior checked against direct likelihood enumeration
separable-control agreement on isolated feature curves
MPS versus CPU held-out prediction parity
checkpoint/resume preserves optimizer, schedule and RNG
raw sums/counts reconstruct all recovery metrics
analytic linear p2 and square p4 calibration including tilted quadratic
artifact/source/protocol hashes and plotted values independently checked
stopping_rule: 60 new networks finish the fixed budget; all six checkpoints plus the specified historical checkpoints are characterized. Complete checks and a concise report with failures/flags. No additional model families, tasks or activation functions without an explicit separately logged follow-up.
